title: Public API, webhooks và automation acceptance
scope_items: Target 1 (Read-only key cannot mutate): Invariants RULE-S24-002, RULE-S24-003, and EC-S24-001/002 are strictly enforced. Keys with read-only scopes or belonging to Starter tier workspaces cannot execute mutating operations (POST, PATCH, DELETE, RPC command procedures), returning HTTP 403 / connect.CodePermissionDenied. Sliding window rate limiting enforces 100 req/min read and 30 req/min write per key with standard X-RateLimit-* and Retry-After headers.

Target 2 (Replay-safe outbound webhook): S24 §5.1 / §21.2 outbound webhook delivery with HMAC-SHA256 signatures, stripping confidential cost/margin details, exponential backoff retries (1s/10s/60s), auto-suspension after 100 consecutive failures (RULE-S24-006), and replay safety with durable delivery tracking in api_webhook_deliveries.

Target 3 (All automation node/agent outcomes pass): Full end-to-end integration across M20 Workflow Studio (10 canonical node types: trigger, condition, transform, action, approval, wait, diagnostics, fallback, handoff, terminal), M21 Agent Center (delegated RBAC, budget ceiling pauses, bounded memory compression/cleanup, and audited handoff), and S24 outbound event delivery (workflow.completed webhook with HMAC signature).
verified_sub_slices: Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_ReadOnlyKeyCannotMutate in internal/publicapi passes with go test -race; confirms read allowed, mutating rejected with 403 PermissionDenied, and Starter tier read-only mode enforced.

Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_ReplaySafeOutboundWebhook in internal/publicapi passes with go test -race; confirms HMAC-SHA256 signature, sanitization of sensitive cost/margin fields, replay safety, and auto-suspension after 100 failures.

Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_AllAutomationNodeAndAgentOutcomes in internal/publicapi passes with go test -race; confirms all 10 workflow node types, agent runtime memory/budget outcomes, and outbound webhook delivery.

Tier Caps & Rotation Grace Window: TestAPIKey_TierCapsAndAccessMode and TestAPIKey_RotationWith24HourGracePeriod pass; confirm Starter=3, Pro=10 caps, 24h grace window where both keys authenticate, and 401 after grace expiry.
PostgreSQL 17 Migration: Goose migration 00039 applied and verified with up/down transactional tests in migrator_test.go.
Protobuf Verification: tooling/proto-gen.sh verify passed across Go, TS, and Dart targets with zero drift.
Web Vitest & Build: 44 files, 369 tests pass in apps/web; vite build succeeds cleanly including settings/developer view.
Mobile Flutter Suite: 7 tests pass in apps/mobile/test/public_api_test.dart; flutter analyze passes with 0 issues; full suite of 299 mobile tests passes.
CI Quality Gates: check_go.sh, check_flutter.sh, and check_node.sh all pass.

external_gates.description: Outbound webhook signing, retry backoff, sanitization, and replay operate deterministically against customer HTTP endpoints. Real outbound HTTP delivery dispatches when customer webhook endpoints are configured.
